description: Model capabilities registry. Maps model name patterns to their optimal tool calling format. thinkingTags is an array of [open, close] pairs to support model-native thinking formats.

ministral.notes: Mistral reasoning models use native OpenAI-style tool calling

qwen.notes: Qwen reasoning models use native <think> tags, fallback to [THOUGHT]

gpt-4.notes: OpenAI models use native tool calling

gpt-3.5.notes: OpenAI models use native tool calling

claude.notes: Anthropic models use native tool calling

llama.notes: Llama models work better with block-text format

codellama.notes: Code Llama works better with block-text format

deepseek.notes: DeepSeek reasoning models use native <think> tags

nemotron.notes: NVIDIA Nemotron models use block-text format

gemma.notes: Google Gemma models use block-text format

mistral.notes: Generic Mistral models use native tool calling

default.notes: Conservative default - block_text works with most OSS models without JSON escaping issues
